key_idea: Dijkstra on the layered state (cell, number of people already notified), with a zero-cost transition to the next layer whenever the current cell is within Euclidean range of the next person.
sketch: States: r*c*(p+1) <= 270k. Moves to a free neighbouring cell cost that cell's entry time; the start cell's entry time is also paid. From (cell,k), if dr^2+dc^2 <= h_k^2 for person k, move to (cell,k+1) for free (several people can be notified from the same cell). Answer is the first popped state with k=p, else -1; also -1 if the upper-left cell is a person. Person cells are impassable. Pitfalls: parsing mixed integer/letter tokens, comparing squared distances in integers, and remembering the cost of the start cell.
